name: Oil painting restyle
description: Restyle the video as animated oil painting with visible brushstrokes, layered pigments and rich canvas texture.

prompt.default: Repaint every frame, from the very first, as a thick oil painting: heavy impasto brushstrokes, layered pigment and visible canvas weave. No photographic texture remains. Preserve the source subjects, action, camera motion and timing. Keep the visual treatment consistent across frames.
